verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe built-in high availability with automatic Raft leader election in the open-source server, list clustering as a feature, and offer HA, dedicated clusters with no record limits, and auto scaling on Typesense Cloud, with Kubernetes and Docker Swarm deployment paths. The largest demonstrated dataset is 32M songs, well short of hundreds of millions. Community users raised unresolved worries that an in-memory, non-sharded index limits dataset size; this is skepticism rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: a detailed clustering/replication setup guide in evidence, a sharding or horizontal partitioning path, demonstrated scale at hundreds of millions of documents, and independent at-scale production corroboration.
